pages.quiz:
MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   C. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   D. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. Best practice when working on Elements of Music RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Elements of Music RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   C. Damage equipment used for Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Elements of Music RESPONDING.

3. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Dance.
   B. Damage equipment used for Dance.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Dance.
   D. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

5. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.
   D. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. Only the costume
   C. The ticket price
   D. The speed of the music

8. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.
   C. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.

9. Best practice when working on Singing Games: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Singing Games.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Singing Games.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Singing Games.
   D. Practise Singing Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Green, orange, and purple

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm COMPOSING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Elements of Music RESPONDING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. A — Practise Elements of Music RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. D — Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. D — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

5. D — Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. D — Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. D — The speed of the music

8. C — Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. D — Practise Singing Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. C — Red, blue, and yellow

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Dance; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Melody; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Elements of Music RESPONDING; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
